preconditions.description: Number of teams n is between 1 and 1000.
Each team beats the other teams exactly k times, where k is between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The number of matches m is equal to n times k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in matches)
postconditions.description: Each match involves two distinct teams between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(matches.count((a_i, b_i)) == 1 for a_i in range(1, n+1) for b_i in range(1, n+1) if a_i != b_i)
postconditions.description: Each pair of teams plays against each other exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for a_i, b_i in matches if a_i == i) == k for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each team wins exactly k matches.
